title: Patch optional Go tooling for newly published HTTP vulnerabilities

evidence.command: Official HTTPS archive checksum verified; actual Go1.26.9, boundary8/framework32 and scope review pass; Nix unrun recorded.

handoff: Optional toolchain patched; candidate x/net and exact final binary qualification remain.
